k:現.mnemonic: A king (王) you can see (見). The king is present, he has appeared. Present (appear).

k:相.mnemonic: An eye (目) and a tree (木) looking at each other. Mutual (minister, phase).
k:相.hint: Eye and tree face each other.

k:馬.mnemonic: A horse: mane at the top, body, and four legs (the flames) underneath. Horse.

k:引.mnemonic: A bow (弓) and a stick (｜): the string being pulled back. Pull.

k:都.mnemonic: Someone (者) in the borough (阝). Where all the people are is the metropolis. Metropolis (capital).

k:泉.mnemonic: White (白) over water (水): clear white water bubbling up from a spring. Spring (water source).

k:線.mnemonic: A thread (糸) from a spring (泉): the water runs out in one thin line. Line.

k:爪.mnemonic: A hand reaching down with claws out. Claw.

k:受.mnemonic: A claw (爪) above, a forehead (冖), and a hand (又) below: one hand passes something over the cover to another. Receive (accept).

k:数.mnemonic: A woman (女) counts rice (米) grains while trudging (夂) home. Number (count).

k:産.mnemonic: Stand (立) under an overhang (厂) and life (生) begins. Produce (give birth).

k:乙.mnemonic: A fishhook, curved with a barb. Fishhook (the latter, second).

k:雨.mnemonic: A cloud with four drops of rain falling out of it. Rain.

k:電.mnemonic: Rain (雨) over a rice field (田) with a fishhook (乙) of lightning tail: electricity. Electricity.

k:午.mnemonic: A thousand (千) crossed with dry (干): the sun has dried a thousand things by noon. Noon.

k:在.mnemonic: Ten thousand (万) things on the soil (土). They exist right there. Exist.

k:火.mnemonic: A person (人) with flames flying off both sides. Fire.

k:身.mnemonic: A pregnant figure in profile with a big belly. Somebody, a body, oneself. Somebody.

k:品.mnemonic: Three boxes stacked in a pyramid: crates of goods. Goods (article, quality).

k:安.mnemonic: A woman (女) under a roof (宀), safe and able to relax. Relax (cheap, peaceful).

k:史.mnemonic: A mouth (口) with a slide (ノ) through it and a stroke to the side: a hand holding a record of what was said. History.

k:右.mnemonic: A hand (the ナ) over a mouth (口): you cover your mouth with your right hand. Right.

k:占.mnemonic: A divining rod (卜) over a mouth (口): the fortune teller reads the rod and speaks. Fortune-telling (occupy).

k:吏.mnemonic: Right (右) with a drop (丶): the right-hand man with a seal, an officer. Officer.

k:使.mnemonic: A leader (亻) and an officer (吏). The leader uses the officer to get things done. Use (messenger).

k:点.mnemonic: Fortune-telling (占) over flames (灬): the fortune teller burns a bone and reads the point where it cracks. Point (spot, mark).

k:円.mnemonic: A hood (冂) with a stick and a line inside: a round coin seen from the side, squared off for drawing. Circle (yen).

k:加.mnemonic: Power (力) with a mouth (口): add your voice and add your strength. Add.

k:位.mnemonic: A leader (亻) standing (立) in place: their rank. Rank (position).
